metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - OFFICE 365 - Mailbox Permission Change - Everyone Allowed
properties.description:
detects suspicious mailbox activity. Everyone allowed is insecure.
possible false positives can be an admin working on the mailbox, but they should remove this permission once work is completed.
properties.query:
//detects suspicious mailbox activity. Everyone allowed is insecure.
//possible false positives can be an admin working on the mailbox, but they should remove this permission once work is completed.
OfficeActivity
| where Operation == "ModifyFolderPermissions"
| where Item has ("everyone")
| where Item has ("top of information store")
  | extend
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("UserId", "")),
    SourceIP = tostring(column_ifexists("ClientIP", ""))
